page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred short lines; below it a centred signature "IACOBI" and a woodcut ornament (no text).
page.notes: The first word is a damaged initial, read as "[?]ellorum" (probably "Bellorum"); the Greek line "δότηρ ἐάων" is uncertain and may be misprinted. "ani" in the verse is likely "aui" (ancestors). "vlbres." is likely "Vlbres" (Kalends place name, Urbes). The date "cIↄ. Iↄ. xcvii" reads MDXCVII. Woodcut ornament below the signature is not transcribed; no page number, running head or catchword is printed.
